methods.name: impact_analysis
methods.description: Impact analysis in four passes, from the need down to what is built (requirements, functional, logical, physical)
methods.guidance: Go down the layers in order and finish one before starting the next: the requirements (needs and requirements), the functional layer (functions), the logical layer (applications, with their solutions, interfaces, flows and data), the physical layer (components and their build artifacts). In each pass, name only what the change itself carries at that layer; the propagation finds the rest, and every element it finds is qualified: kept when the change concerns it, rejected with the reason and withdrawn otherwise. What the change needs that does not exist yet is planned in its pass (a planned creation: a type, a key, why), written later by the specification or the design; on a green field the passes find nothing existing and plan what is new.

processes.name: software_delivery
processes.description: Deliver a change phase by phase — framing, analysis, design, build, release, application

steps.name: framing
steps.description: Frame the change with its requester, its description reviewed as soon as it is written

steps.name: review
steps.description: Rate the title and the description, propose a better wording, answer the requester's remarks

steps.name: confirmation
steps.description: A person confirms the framing, in the light of the review of the description
steps.guidance: A well-framed change can be analysed without going back to the requester: the outcome is observable, the scope names the applications or requirements concerned, and the reason says what happens if nothing is done. The review is an advice: its findings and its proposed wording are for the requester to take or leave.
checklist: The outcome is concrete and observable
The scope names what the change touches
The reason for the change is stated

steps.name: analysis
steps.description: Impacts, requirements, traceability and test plan, once the change is framed and its description accepted

steps.name: impacts
steps.description: The impact analysis, in four passes (the impact_analysis method)

steps.name: specification
steps.description: Requirements (once the impacts are known), then their traceability and their tests

steps.name: design
steps.description: Allocate the functions and design the solution, by the method that fits the change, once the requirements are specified

steps.name: build
steps.description: Build every component in scope, from its sources in the workspace of the change when its repository is known, else according to its technology (once the design is checked)

steps.name: release
steps.description: Plan, note, review and roll out the releases, once what the release train needs holds and the risks are under control

steps.name: application
steps.description: Apply the change to the ALM repository once reviewed and rolled out, after the changes it depends on

processes.name: release_train
processes.description: Release — plan the releases, write the release note, review, deploy environment by environment

steps.name: approval
steps.description: Approve the requirements the review accepted

steps.name: rollout
steps.description: Deploy each release wave by wave, from dev to production

methods.name: description_rating
methods.description: Rate the description of the change, by a model first, by a person when no model can

methods.name: impact_analysis
methods.description: Impact analysis in four passes, from the need down to what is built (requirements, functional, logical, physical)

steps.name: requirements
steps.description: First pass: the needs and requirements the change concerns

steps.name: identify
steps.description: Name the needs and requirements the intent directly concerns (a person if it fails)

steps.name: propagate
steps.description: Propagate to the needs and requirements (satisfies, refines)

steps.name: qualify
steps.description: Qualify each suspected need or requirement

steps.name: functions
steps.description: Second pass, the functional layer: the functions realizing the impacted requirements

steps.name: identify
steps.description: Name the functions the change directly concerns

steps.name: propagate
steps.description: Propagate to the functions realizing the impacted requirements

steps.name: qualify
steps.description: Qualify each suspected function

steps.name: applications
steps.description: Third pass, the logical layer: applications, solutions, interfaces, flows and data

steps.name: identify
steps.description: Name the elements of the logical layer the change directly concerns

steps.name: propagate
steps.description: Propagate to the applications, solutions, interfaces, flows and data

steps.name: qualify
steps.description: Qualify each suspected element of the logical layer

steps.name: components
steps.description: Fourth pass, the physical layer: components and build artifacts

steps.name: identify
steps.description: Name the components the change directly concerns

steps.name: propagate
steps.description: Propagate to the components and their build artifacts

steps.name: qualify
steps.description: Qualify each suspected component or artifact

steps.name: validation
steps.description: A person reviews the impacts layer by layer and validates the analysis

methods.name: solution_design
methods.description: Architecture of the components, interfaces, flows and data the change touches

steps.name: allocation
steps.description: Allocate the requirements to functions

steps.name: design
steps.description: Design the components, interfaces, flows and data (by the agent, a person if it fails)

steps.name: check
steps.description: Check the consistency of the design

methods.name: functional_design
methods.description: Functional allocation and a design note written by hand, when no component is touched

steps.name: allocation
steps.description: Allocate the requirements to functions

steps.name: note
steps.description: Write the design note by hand

steps.name: check
steps.description: Check the consistency of the design

methods.name: workspace_build
methods.description: Implement, build and test the components in their sources, in the workspace of the change, then publish them

methods.name: recorded_build
methods.description: Record the build of each component according to its technology (no sources to build from)

applications_confirmed.description: Every suspected element of the logical layer is confirmed

applications_identified.description: The pass on the logical layer named the applications, interfaces, flows and data the change directly concerns

applications_propagated.description: The impacts are propagated to the logical layer (applications, solutions, interfaces, flows, data)

applied.description: The change is applied to the ALM repository (new baseline)

build_complete.description: Each impacted or created component has a build artifact

components_confirmed.description: Every suspected element of the physical layer is confirmed

components_identified.description: The pass on the physical layer named the components and artifacts the change directly concerns

components_propagated.description: The impacts are propagated to the physical layer (components, build artifacts)

dependencies_met.description: the changes this change depends on have merged

description_accepted.description: the description is rated, with a score of 3 or more

description_rated.description: the description, as it reads now, has a rating answering its last remark

design_checked.description: The consistency of the design is checked

design_done.description: The design (components, interfaces, flows, data) is described

functions_allocated.description: Each new requirement is realized by a function

functions_identified.description: The pass on the functional layer named the functions the change directly concerns

functions_propagated.description: The impacts are propagated to the functions realizing the impacted requirements

impact_analysis_validated.description: A person validated the impact analysis, the four passes done

pending:impact_analysis/applications/qua.description: the action impact_analysis/applications/qualify is still to be done for some impact

pending:impact_analysis/components/quali.description: the action impact_analysis/components/qualify is still to be done for some impact

pending:impact_analysis/functions/qualif.description: the action impact_analysis/functions/qualify is still to be done for some impact

pending:impact_analysis/requirements/qua.description: the action impact_analysis/requirements/qualify is still to be done for some impact

release_planned.description: The releases of the affected applications are built (artifacts, version, environment chain)

requirements_approved.description: The requirements the review accepted are approved (ADR 0076, 0077)

requirements_confirmed.description: Every suspected need or requirement is confirmed

requirements_identified.description: The pass on the requirements named the needs and requirements the change directly concerns

requirements_propagated.description: The impacts are propagated to the requirements (needs, refinements)

requirements_traced.description: Each new requirement satisfies a need (or refines another one)

reviewed.description: All the change impacts have received a decision (the deployments are recorded accepted, after the review)

risks_under_control.description: every high risk has a mitigation action

rolled_out.description: Each release is deployed to every environment in the chain (or there is nothing to deploy)

sources_published.description: Every component built from its sources is published (true when there is none)

step:software_delivery/framing/confirmat.description: the step software_delivery/framing/confirmation has run, and what it did still stands

tests_planned.description: Each created or revised requirement is verified by a created test case
